propositions: The shared query ticket digest is re-sent in the volatile user message for all N calls in a batch, incurring full token cost each time, when it could be relocated to the stable system prompt to be cached after the first call.

Relocating the query digest to the system prompt from the user message requires verifying that the resulting stable prefix size exceeds the model's minimum cacheable prefix (measured at 1024 tokens for claude-sonnet-4-6, not the 4096 constant in the codebase).
The measured stable prefix after the hoist is 846 tokens, below the 1024-token floor, resulting in zero cache reads and a +936 token (+5.8%) regression despite the relocation.

Precision of the overlap judge (relation, shared_artifact, confidence per ordered pair) must remain unchanged when the inline digest is replaced by a system-prompt reference, verified by verdict-parity over the same corpus.
